To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ANFIS algorithm is found to be the best algorithm for the identification of the AVC system model.
the ANFIS algorithm is more suitable to implement the model of AVC systems.
RLS, G As, GRNN, ANFIS, and their combinations are effective for AVC systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of intelligent learning algorithms for an AVC system.
the design, implementation, and performance analysis of an intelligent AVC system.
the development and comparative assessment of an intelligent learning algorithm for AVC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed intelligent learning algorithms are capable of developing an efficient and effective AVC system for the flexible beam system.
the ANFIS algorithm has shown a better performance in terms of convergence rate, computational efficiency, and accuracy.
the proposed intelligent learning algorithms are effective and efficient in the design of AVC systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the AVC system is capable of reducing the vibration of a flexible beam in transverse vibration by using the proposed algorithms.
the proposed intelligent learning algorithms are able to provide an optimal performance in the implementation of AVC system.
the ANFIS and GRNN algorithms are the most suitable algorithms for implementing the AVC system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed algorithms can be effectively used for the design of AVC systems.
the proposed AVC system using the GRNN algorithm outperformed other algorithms.
the ANFIS and GRNN algorithms are more efficient than the RLS and GAs algorithms in implementing the AVC system for the plant model.
